title: SpaceX eyes tower catch for next Starship after auspicious end to 13th flight
summary: Friday’s test flight was the 13th launch of SpaceX’s Starship on top of its massive Super Heavy booster, and the second flight of the latest iteration of the world’s most powerful rocket—Starship Version 3.
